description: Expander that drives Conductor from a grid of eight pads, with pages so that more than eight patterns can be reached

params.text: Steps the page number down by one
Steps the page number up by one
Queues its pattern in Conductor, or takes it out of the queue if it was already queued; which pattern that is depends on the page

notes: the module has to be placed touching the right-hand side of Conductor or of another Conductor expander; anywhere else it does nothing
the pad for the queued pattern blinks blue and the pad for the pattern now playing is lit red
the upper display reads the page number and the lower one the pattern queued in Conductor
the two page buttons have no hover text of their own; the panel marks them with a minus and a plus
the module has no jacks at all; it reaches Conductor through the expander connection alone
